verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents public HTTP APIs across its products: Directory Sync APIs, RBAC role assignment via API, the AuthKit migration API, and an Events API. A live probe found a public OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json and llms.txt. Official SDKs ship automatic retries, pagination and typed clients, and the MCP docs confirm agents can manage organizations, connections and users by calling the WorkOS API. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API directly (community evidence covers SSO/SCIM ease, not API automation).
